description.zh: 房间内的浏览器点对点通道：信令走现有 /ws，数据走 DataChannel，连不上就回退 WebSocket。默认随房间启用，可被房间内容集或 ?p2p=0 关掉。
description.en: A browser-to-browser side channel for one room: signaling over /ws, app frames over a DataChannel, WebSocket whenever it is not open. On by default; a room can drop it or ?p2p=0 turns it off.
